title: Noor and the Promise
author: Ansel Vane
blurb: Ulyana Galloway, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
